x: Scott was an easy winner from Stan Eeles. Our Field Events men have always had keen contests with the Police—I believe they almost regard their section as a match on its own, and we usually get keen and close competition.

The chief feature of the race was the forward running of several of the younger school, particularly Stan Eeles who perhaps ran his best race to date—Stan has the makings of a real runner if he will get down to it, Fred Clay, John Brown, Bob Boyden, Norman Walker and Alf Heathfield.
Stan Eeles showed a return to the form he had earlier in the season and amazed the three by dashing past to set up a gap which he maintained.
